# Pedasenticom (pedasenticom.co.zw)

> Pedasenticom is an education and technology (EdTech) company headquartered in Harare, Zimbabwe, officially registered under CIPZ (Companies and Intellectual Property Zimbabwe). Its flagship platform, Edu-Connect (transitioning to the name Pedacom), connects schools, teachers, and parents through a unified administrative web portal, Android mobile application, and multi-currency USD & ZiG EcoCash payment gateway.

## Entity Profile & Facts
- **Official Company Name:** Pedasenticom
- **Corporate Slogan:** Inspired to Advance Your Global Reach
- **Legal Registration:** Registered in Zimbabwe under CIPZ (Companies and Intellectual Property Zimbabwe)
- **Headquarters / Location:** Harare, Zimbabwe
- **Service Area:** Primary and Secondary Schools across Zimbabwe and Southern Africa
- **Industry / Sector:** Education Technology (EdTech), School Management Software, Digital School Fee & Uniform Payments
- **Flagship Product:** Edu-Connect (to be named Pedacom)
- **Primary Platforms:** Multi-Tenant Administrative Web Portal & Android Mobile Application
- **Payment Infrastructure:** EcoCash multi-currency payment gateway (USD and ZiG) with automated background reconciliation
- **Engineering & Digital Infrastructure Partner:** Split Technologies (https://splittechnologies.co.zw)
- **Official Website:** https://pedasenticom.co.zw/
- **Official Email:** Pedasenticom@gmail.com
- **Official Phone & WhatsApp:** +263 790 543 013 (0790543013)

## Core Platform Capabilities (Edu-Connect / Pedacom)
1. **Administrative Web Portal (For Platform Owners & School Administrators):**
   - Multi-school onboarding and child-level subscription management
   - Academic year, term, class, staff roster, and student enrollment configuration
   - Multi-currency tuition and fee accounting in both USD and ZiG
   - Digital school uniform store inventory management and school-wide notices
2. **Android Mobile Application (For Teachers, Parents & Guardians):**
   - **Teachers:** Paperless classroom roll call and attendance tracking, homework assignments, merit and conduct logging, activity rosters, and interactive multimedia learning journals (photos, drawings, voice notes, reports, wellbeing logs).
   - **Parents & Guardians:** Real-time visibility across multiple enrolled children (attendance percentages, academic reports, homework deadlines, conduct records), digital uniform ordering, and instant USD/ZiG fee payments via EcoCash.
3. **Central Cloud API & Security Architecture:**
   - Multi-tenant cloud infrastructure with strict 5-role Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
   - Server-enforced school-level data isolation, encrypted HTTPS communication, and administrative guardian-student link verification
4. **EcoCash Payment Gateway Integration:**
   - Local Zimbabwean mobile money payments in USD and ZiG inside the mobile app with automated order verification and reconciliation
